title: Map Builder drag + mask tools at deep zoom
description:
After Map Builder started fitting pages at zoom below 25%, pointer→world math still assumed a 0.25 floor. Hit-testing missed the sheets, so hand-drag and mask brush felt dead on open. World origin also re-centered every bounds sync during drag, which made pieces look stuck.

This release uses the real viewport zoom for board coordinates, keeps the world origin stable while dragging, falls back to DOM sheet hit-testing for hand mode, and caps mask canvases at 2048px so oversized Map sheets no longer fail mask bake/toDataURL.

Who is affected: PipeSync Map Building on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh PipeSync after deploy.
changeLog: Fix pointer→world zoom so drag/mask work when Map Builder opens below 25% zoom.
Keep map world origin stable while dragging sheets.
Hand-mode page pick falls back to the sheet hitbox under the cursor.
Cap mask working canvases so large Map sheets can paint/erase masks again.
